description: Mark Evans had barely stepped over the threshold of his home on a sunny afternoon when a neighbour hammered on his door. 'Your solar panels are on fire,' he shouted.
title: 'We lost everything... I'm just glad we're still here.' Mark lost his home to an inferno caused by his SOLAR PANELS - and he's just one of many worrying Labour's Net Zero drive has left them living in a tinder box
